question: Can an evidence-driven equivalence partition compress the original DTR terminal response table without losing predictive accuracy? Is terminal action x2 dependence needed after public history? No new source or novel-family claim.
prior_work: CKAD16 already established exact Beta parity on same 576/192 split; do not reframe as new gain.
CKAD49 learned a supplied 16-hypothesis partition/operator grammar and failed; WSP111 effect-class discovery tied conventional controls; WSCM fixed parity grammar and SCDR04 no-go preserved.

design.contexts: 8 public histories c=s1+2*x1+4*s2; action x2 binary, outcome y binary; no hidden U, source seed or future label as input
design.fit: first192 of each of three replicas
design.evaluation: remaining64 each; already exposed, descriptive only; score per replica and pooled
design.candidate: start with eight singleton context cells; repeatedly merge the pair with maximal strictly positive log marginal likelihood improvement (Beta(1,1) action-specific evidence), lexicographic tie break; stop at no improvement. Fit pooled beta counts only; no held tuning
controls: exact posterior predictive averaging over all 4140 set partitions of 8 contexts, uniform partition prior, identical Beta action-specific marginal likelihood
all eight feature subsets of (s1,x1,s2), exact evidence-weighted predictive mixture, with and without x2, equal model prior
design.metrics: Brier on existing 192 archived evaluation outcomes, per replica; selected groups and fit counts; number of probability cells vs full 16; exact optimal partition vs greedy; full posterior mass on action-invariant models; observed x2 contrast within context, uncertainty descriptive only
design.gates: at most four context groups, pooled Brier no worse than best fitted comparison +.005 and per replica no worse +.01. If exact tied or better, no unique learning gain. Action-invariant result may show lack of need for x2 effect but not prove causal null. Not a first-use or native capability gate.
design.negative_controls: same partitions under permuted public context identifiers up to tie equivalence; no held labels in fit; exact enumeration count 4140; all input source hashes verified; no new source actions.
